يقتعدون (form VIII)
# يَقْتَعِدُونَ (yaqtaʕidūna) /jaq.ta.ʕi.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# يُقْتَعَدُونَ (yuqtaʕadūna) /juq.ta.ʕa.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
